blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — More than 1.56 million minimum wage earners in Calabarzon are expected to benefit from a daily wage increase of up to P45 starting Oct. 26, following the approval of a new wage order by the Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board (RTWPB 4A). Under Wage Order No. IVA-23, the maximum P45 daily increase translates to an additional P1,170 in monthly earnings for affected workers, the wage board said in a press release on Oct. 10. The actual increase will vary depending on the industry sector and municipality classification across the region. The RTWPB 4A, together with the National […]...
